subject: Various dispatcher improvements

units.name: Various dispatcher improvements
units.evidence: Exact historical child source leaves max_leaves and abcd uninitialized when XXH_DISPATCH_SCALAR=0, then reads them in AVX checks. Alive2 finds a modeled internal backend-ID mismatch, but no defined-behavior public hash counterexample; the public hash target times out and update targets are inconclusive.

units.name: XXH_featureTest with XXH_DISPATCH_SCALAR=1
units.precondition: x86-64-v3, explicit scalar dispatch enabled, same pure CPUID/XGETBV query values
units.evidence: Alive2 bidirectional checks pass for symbolic CPU feature queries and a fixed AVX2 CPU; no unresolved feature-test call remains in the checked IR.

units.name: XXH3_64bits_dispatch for lengths 0 through 240
units.precondition: len <= 240; input points to len valid bytes; Clang 20 x86-64-v3
units.evidence: Exact historical source and default secret retained; two functions pass Alive2 in both directions after symmetric alias-attribute weakening.

notes: The internal feature-test mismatch depends on uninitialized child reads and is not a public C counterexample. The 0–240-byte public XXH3_64bits_dispatch result is proved for the archived Clang build; longer inputs, other APIs, whole-commit behavior, and official performance remain unproved.
